label: Notion
description: Read and write Notion pages, databases, and comments over the public REST API.
notes: Credential unified to NOTION_API_KEY to match the three notion.* nodes already in the live catalog (AP piece offers OAuth2 or internal-token auth; both are bearer tokens against the same API). Simplifications: findPage returns the first page of raw search results (AP's client-side exact-match filtering, pagination loop, and result reshaping dropped); getBlockChildren returns one level of children, first 100 (AP's recursive depth and Markdown conversion dropped); getPageComments returns the first 100 comments unthreaded (AP's pagination and discussion-thread grouping dropped); getDatabase returns the raw database object (AP's formStructure reshaping dropped). Skipped as live-catalog collision: createPage (live notion.createPage is equal coverage; AP adds only an optional first-paragraph content field that cannot be conditionally included). needsPieceRuntime: create_database_item, update_database_item, notion-find-database-item (all retrieve the database schema first and build typed property objects via NotionFieldMapping), append_to_page (Markdown-to-blocks conversion via @tryfabric/martian; plain-paragraph case already covered by live notion.appendBlock). Triggers not transpiled: new-database-item, updated-database-item, new-comment, updated-page.

nodes.label: Notion: Find Page
nodes.description: Search the workspace for pages matching a title query, newest edits first.
nodes.search: notion search find page title lookup locate query workspace

config.label: Search Query
config.help: Full or partial page title to search for

credentials.help: Internal integration secret (ntn_… / secret_…) from notion.so/my-integrations, or an OAuth2 access token; pages must be shared with the integration

nodes.label: Notion: Get Block Children
nodes.description: List the content blocks directly inside a page or block (first 100).
nodes.search: notion page content blocks children read fetch body text list

config.label: Page or Block ID
config.help: ID of the page or parent block whose children to list

credentials.help: Internal integration secret from notion.so/my-integrations; the page must be shared with the integration

nodes.label: Notion: Archive Database Item
nodes.description: Move a database item (page) to the trash so it can be restored later.
nodes.search: notion archive delete trash remove database item page soft delete

config.label: Item ID
config.help: Page ID of the database item to archive

credentials.help: Internal integration secret with edit access to the item's database

nodes.label: Notion: Restore Database Item
nodes.description: Bring an archived database item (page) back to active status.
nodes.search: notion restore unarchive undelete recover database item page

config.label: Item ID
config.help: Page ID of the archived database item to restore

credentials.help: Internal integration secret with edit access to the item's database

nodes.label: Notion: Add Comment
nodes.description: Post a plain-text comment as a new thread on a page.
nodes.search: notion comment add post note feedback discussion reply page

config.label: Page ID
config.help: ID of the page to comment on

credentials.help: Internal integration secret with the 'Insert comments' capability enabled

nodes.label: Notion: Get Page Comments
nodes.description: List the comments on a page or block (first 100).
nodes.search: notion comments list read fetch page discussion feedback threads

config.label: Page or Block ID
config.help: ID of the page or block whose comments to list

credentials.help: Internal integration secret with the 'Read comments' capability enabled

nodes.label: Notion: Get Database
nodes.description: Fetch a database's metadata and property schema.
nodes.search: notion database schema structure properties retrieve fields columns metadata

config.label: Database ID
config.help: The 32-char database ID from the database URL

credentials.help: Internal integration secret; the database must be shared with the integration
